easy.q: Which structure captures light energy to make sugar in a plant cell?
Which statement about cell walls is correct?
choices: Only animal cells have a cell wall.
All cells have a cell wall.
Plant cells have a cell wall; animal cells do not.
Cell walls make sugar from light.

easy.q: Explain what chloroplasts and mitochondria do in a plant cell.
easy.rubric: Award 2 marks: 1 for chloroplasts using light to make sugar; 1 for mitochondria releasing energy from food. Accept equivalent wording.
